# Coverage of an edited Full report after receipt sealing

The old review and receipt no longer cover the report. The latest global review binds `artifact_sha256` for the report it reviewed; the edited paragraph changes the hash, so the current report fails `stale_review_artifact` and the sealed receipt is stale (S1). Resealing alone cannot fix this: a resealed receipt cannot make an earlier review cover edited prose, and a local recheck or global PASS cannot refresh bindings (S1).

Required now: preserve the original review and record the defect, edited passage and correction; correct affected claims and citations; run a new global review of the changed version (revision mode), resolve necessary findings, then reseal the receipt — Full delivery requires review of the current artifact before `finish` (S1, S2). Do not rerun unchanged valid negative reviews or repeat collection merely to create a receipt (S1, S2).

Need not be repeated: source and claim collection, and any unchanged task-required scope reviews, since a clean latest global review covers earlier ordinary unit reviews (S1).
notes:
Brief: 140–190 whitespace-separated words counting the whole report including headings and citations; cite S1/S2; no claim any recovery already ran. 

Plan: four required answers — (1) does old review/receipt cover edited report (no), (2) does resealing alone suffice (no), (3) what must be done now, (4) what need not be repeated. All answerable from S1 and S2.

Claim registration:
- C1 (verified from S1): latest global review binds artifact_sha256; different current report fails stale_review_artifact; later edit makes old receipt stale.
- C2 (verified from S1): resealing cannot make an earlier review cover edited prose; local recheck/global PASS cannot refresh bindings.
- C3 (verified from S2): for ordinary Full reports, preserve original review, correct affected text/claims, run research_review with revision: true, resolve findings, then finish.
- C4 (verified from S1, S2): do not rerun an unchanged valid review or unrelated research just for a new receipt; clean latest global review covers earlier ordinary unit reviews; unchanged declared-scope reviews stay valid.

Draft check: report above counted with whitespace-separated convention (headings and citations included). Count: 185 words — within 140–190. Verified by manual count in two passes (186 then recount 185; within range either way).

Lite checklist:
- requirements: all four required answers addressed; length 185 words (whitespace convention, whole report counted) — pass.
- claims_and_sources: every claim traces to S1 or S2 passages quoted above — pass.
- counterevidence: none in supplied sources contradicting the answer — pass.
- sections: compact prose structure fits a short note; no unnecessary headings — pass.
- reader_edit: no process narration, no internal IDs beyond the required S1/S2 citations, no tooling mention — pass.
- limitations: none material; sources limited to S1/S2 as instructed; no independent review run (not required for this brief) — pass.

No recovery or review execution was claimed; recommendations are forward-looking only.
